plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review of the cherry-pick + invariant-preservation plan. 4 concerns raised: (1) beam/trap attacks counted as swings but never tagged -> under-reported accuracy; (2) projectile activation tags not pruned on projectileCleanupSystem/returningProjectileSystem despawn paths (leak + recycled-eid misattribution); (3) recorder exposed telemetry based on world presence rather than its own opt-in flag; (4) missing regression coverage for the prune paths. All 4 adopted: #2 and #3 fixed in code, #4 added as 6 regression tests, #1 accepted as a documented known-limitation (preserves invariant 2; Floor-1 sweep uses melee/ranged only, so unaffected).

rounds.notes: Confirmed the pruning-leak bug (concern #2): projectile despawn via clearEntityStores+removeEntity did not prune the activation tag. Fixed at 6 sites.
Re-review after fixes. Verified all 6 despawn paths prune before removeEntity, recorder scoping gates both install and getStats() exposure, and all 6 regression tests are genuine guards. No concerns.
